build_natural_questions_open_data: run the build function to download and decompress the NaturalQuestions Open dataset files
download_nq_gold_info: download the NaturalQuestions gold info JSON files for train, dev, and test splits
decompress_gz_files: decompress gzip compressed JSON files to plain JSON format in the data directory
check_data_version: check if the NaturalQuestions Open dataset is already built at the current version
remove_outdated_data: remove outdated versions of the NaturalQuestions Open dataset before rebuilding
